Name: Underestimating the Elders - A George and Evelyn Expansion
Author: LenoraRose
Description:
UPDATE NOTE: 
[b][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41422]Pelican Town Accessibility[/url][/i][/b] will allow for the map change needed after one of George's events. Someday, I will include native support for it, but today is not that day..

Everyone has history, and who we were informs who we are.

This is a small-scale mod about George and Evelyn, and their connections to the other townsfolk (and the farmer).

Includes a modest number of new dialogue lines for George and Evelyn, 13 events featuring one or both as they go about their lives, and a minuscule number of conversation topic comments for various villagers. 
[b]
Evelyn[/b] might be losing her sight, but her memory is sharp. She knows a lot more about her neighbours than she likes to talk about, and she tries to see the best in people - but she's not naive. 

[b]George [/b]is a grouch, and he'd rather be alone with his wife and grandson … but maybe there are reasons he's such a curmudgeon. 

Nothing included here contradicts vanilla canon, but it does expand on characters, and even I was occasionally surprised by the directions it went.

[b][u]Event triggers list:[/u][/b]
[b]
Intro/Both:[/b]
George and Evelyn at 2 hearts, enter their house on a rainy day.

[b]George:[/b]
 [i](This is a discrete plot arc aside from the last one)[/i]

1: Enter Pierre's on a Sunday, George at 3 hearts

2: Have seen Event 1. George at 3 hearts, Gus at 2. Enter the Saloon on a Friday night. 
[i](NB: Following this, there SHOULD BE a small but significant change to the town map. If you have [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41422]Pelican Town Accessibility[/url][/b] , you will see the needed change. If not, for now you may have to pretend.)[/i]

3: Have seen event 2. Enter the saloon after 5 any Friday after the prior event.  (NB: the farmer is only a witness.)

4: Have seen event 3; George at 4 hearts, Gus at 3. Enter the saloon after 5 any day BUT Friday,  at least a week after the previous event. [i]George's schedule changes slightly after this event.[/i]

5: Have seen event 4; 8 hearts with George and Willy. Enter the beach while Willy is fishing. Varies slightly depending on fishing skill. No plot, just a slice of life.

[b]Evelyn: [/b]
[i](separate events, linked by theme. Can mostly be viewed in any order)[/i]

1: Sometime after completing the greenhouse, Caroline sends a letter with a request to the farmer. 
﻿1a: Once this quest is completed, enter town any sunny day outside of winter for a brief cutscene.

2: Must be year 2+: Jodi and Evelyn at 3+ hearts, enter Jodi and Kent's house anytime before 6 pm.

3: Must have finished the Community Centre. Enter town on a blackberry-picking day.

4a: Once Leo has moved to the mainland, enter town on a sunny day. (You will receive a follow-up letter in the mail)

4b: 5+ days after 4a, enter the mountains on a sunny day.[i] (NB: The farmer is not present)[/i]

5: Evelyn and Penny both at 7 hearts. Enter the Museum while Penny is present.[i] (NB: The farmer is not present)[/i]

6: Evelyn at 10 hearts. Have seen Evelyn's event 5. Enter Saloon any evening between Winter 10 and 22 (except her birthday).[i] (NB: the farmer is only a witness.)[/i]

All dialogue is added via i18n, to make translation easier.[u] Human translations, NOT AI.[/u] Non-AI machine translations should be fully checked by a speaker of both languages for consistency and flow.

[b][u]Compatibility:[/u][/b]

[b][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41422]Pelican Town Accessibility[/url][/i] [/b]pairs well with this and was kind enough to include a compatibility condition.

[b]LucytheDove [/b]was kind enough to ensure her [i][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44845]Evelyn Expansion[/url][/b] [/i]is fully compatible, and I endorse using both if you want to see more of these characters.

Lore-wise, some assumptions that might contradict other mods: All canon town couples are either happily married, or are working on their relationships, and all *want* to be together.  Evelyn's memory and hearing are just fine. Alex helps around the house. 

Hasn't been tested with many other dialogue addition mods, but the standard rules for dialogue load order will apply. I know there's some date/heart levels overlap with the [b]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion.[/b] There [b]is[/b] an option available to work with their festival dialogue changes, because they were kind enough to explain to me what their code was doing with the festivals in the first place. The only lore discrepancy between the two is a line in Canon-friendly (which I think contradicts vanilla).

Events are set up with vanilla spaces in mind, and have not been tested with mods that change maps significantly, including SVE. For interior spaces, mods that add rooms should be fine; ones that move furniture or change room shapes may not.

Should be compatible with any portrait/sprite mods, as I did not add any new portraits (Even where I really really wanted to). I tried not to add any dialogue that would clash with the cultural and religious options in Diverse Stardew Valley, but I also didn't add lines that directly address them. (I don't belong to any of the relevant cultures/faiths, so will humbly accept suggestions for alternatives that do so).



[b]Future Plans:[/b]
[list]
[*]Possibly my own map change for those who don't want to use PTA.[/*]
[*]I have vague script ideas for a few more events, but no guarantees for any of them.[/*]
[*]Confirm/create compatibility with SVE maps – and possibly other maps if requested.[/*]
[*]More conversation topic reactions from other townsfolk and possibly some light dialogue adds.[/*]
[/list][i]I DO NOT give permission to use generative AI to alter or add to anything in this mod. [/i]
